eps.t: Justice Sonia and Judge Alma / Justice Sonia and Umpire Alma
eps.o: "Justice Sonia and Judge Alma": Inspired by Supreme Court Justice Sonia Sotomayor, Alma tries to help her friends determine what's fair. "Justice Sonia and Umpire Alma": Justice Sotomayor encourages Alma to be an umpire at a kickball game.

eps.t: To Break or Not to Break? / The New Mr. Octy
eps.o: "To Break or Not to Break?": Alma senses that Beto is hesitant about breaking his pinata and wants to find out why. "The New Mr. Octy": Alma regrets her decision to give away an old toy she doesn't play with anymore.

eps.t: Mofongo on the Go Go / Alma Scoots Around
eps.o: "Mofongo on the Go Go": Alma and Eddie open a mofongo food truck, but they ran out of time to make the mofongo. "Alma Scoots Around": Alma challenges André to scooter races to prove she is faster.

eps.t: Piragua Problem / Balloon Blues
eps.o: "Piragua Problem": Mr. Piragua Man names a new flavor after Alma. But it turns out that Alma doesn't like the taste of all her colors she chose for her 'Alma Special'. Meanwhile, Mr. Piragua Man keeps giving her the same piragua over and over again. What could Alma do to solve her piragua problem? She thinks about it, and realizes that Howard could use Alma's piragua at the end - it was called…

eps.t: Alma the B-Girl / Chacho's Birthday
eps.o: "Alma the B-Girl": Junior gets frustrated when Alma distracts him from learning a dance. "Chacho's Birthday": Alma wants to celebrate Chacho's birthday.

eps.t: The Missing Vote / Alma's Lemonade and Everything Else Stand
eps.o: "The Missing Vote": Alma and her friends must vote for either a new board game or art supplies. "Alma's Lemonade and Everything Else Stand": Alma and Harper open a lemonade stand.

eps.t: Howard Brings the Beat / Alma's Payday
eps.o: "Howard Brings the Beat": Alma helps Howard find a drum when he joins the neighborhood drum circle. "Alma's Payday": Alma and Junior try to earn toy tickets.

eps.t: A Tale of Two Almas / The Longest Race
eps.o: "A Tale of Two Almas": Alma teaches Emi how to be like her, but now Emi won't stop imitating Alma. "The Longest Race": Alma tries to finish running the world's longest race.

eps.t: Goodbye, Howard! / Re-Use Re-Do
eps.o: "Goodbye, Howard!": Alma tells all her friends that Howard is moving. "Re-Use Re-do": Alma wonders if she should buy new materials for her recycled art project.

eps.t: Museum Day Way / Bronxorama Diorama
eps.o: "Museum Day Way": Alma wants to see everything at the museum fast, and Junior wants to go slow. "Bronxorama Diorama": Alma's friends want to add their favorite things to Alma's Bronx diorama.

eps.t: Alma's Yes Day / Alma's Hypothe-Saur
eps.o: "Alma's Yes Day": When the family agrees to a day of saying yes to everyone and everything, Alma realizes that sometimes you have to say no. "Alma's Hypothe-Saur": Alma helps Junior and Emi test out their dinosaur hypotheses at the American Museum of Natural History.

eps.t: Uncle Nestor's Bumpy Ride / Grocery Goof
eps.o: "Uncle Nestor's Bumpy Ride": Alma and Junior try to teach Uncle Nestor how to ride his first bike. "Grocery Goof": When Papi lets Alma go to the grocery store by herself, she realizes that she needs to focus to complete her mission.

eps.t: A Gift for Granny / Soccer Friends
eps.o: "A Gift For Granny": Alma is putting together a care package for Granny Isa, but did she pack the right things? "Soccer Friends": Alma hypes up Beto and Rafia so much that they get nervous to play each other in soccer.

eps.t: Alma Wings It / The Grandparent Trap
eps.o: "Alma Wings It": Granny Isa teaches Alma and Junior how to be flight attendants. "The Grandparent Trap": Alma tries to get her grandparents to remarry so her whole family can be together all the time.

eps.t: World's Greatest Playdate / What Alma Wants
eps.o: "World's Greatest Playdate": Alma feels jealous when Rafia and Lucas won't stop talking about their fun playdate. "What Alma Wants": Conflicting opinions influence whether or not Alma wants to see a new movie. But what does Alma want to do?

eps.t: No Sleep 'til New Year's / Nurse Alma
eps.o: "No Sleep 'til New Year's": Alma and Junior want to stay awake until midnight on New Year's Eve, but will they make it? "Nurse Alma": When Eddie Mambo gets sick, Alma gets impatient waiting for him to feel better.

eps.t: Big Kid Hangout / Little Brother Loan
eps.o: "Big Kid Hangout": Alma is invited to a hangout with Eddie's friends, but she doesn't like it when she starts to feel like a little kid. "Little Brother Loan": When Alma is too busy for her little brother, Junior becomes everyone else's pretend little brother.

eps.t: Subway All-Stars / Bunches of Beads
eps.o: "Subway All-Stars": Alma, Eddie, and Uncle Nestor are performing music on the subway when another musician shows up, thinking it's her day to play. "Bunches of Beads": Alma volunteers Andre to make necklaces for all of their friends.

eps.t: Alma on the Moo-ve / The Lucas Look
eps.o: "Alma on the Moo-ve": When Papi is called to rescue a cow, Alma becomes attached to her and wants to convince her dad to let Ms. Moo stay in the Bronx! "The Lucas Look": Lucas gets upset after Alma, Eddie, and Lauren copy his new hairstyle.

eps.t: Alma's Summertime Musical
eps.o: Alma and Eddie want to win the Song of Summer Contest, but what should their song be about?

eps.t: Alma-Papi Day / Alma's Special Ticket
eps.o: "Alma-Papi Day": When Alma-Papi Day keeps getting interrupted, Alma realizes that spending time together is what matters. "Alma's Special Ticket": Alma gives up her concert ticket to Elyssa B's biggest fan... Eddie.

eps.t: To Tell or Not to Tell / Potluck Snack Time
eps.o: "To Tell or Not to Tell": Alma tells on Emi when she's doing something dangerous, but tells on Beto and Eddie when they weren't doing anything wrong. "Potluck Snack Time": All of Alma's friends bring snacks to share, but no one tries Aaron and Lucas' snacks.

eps.t: Rubberiest Rubber Bands / Donuts for Doggies
eps.o: "Rubberiest Rubber Bands": When the Huda Store mistakenly gets a delivery of too many rubber bands, Alma and Rafia try to give them away. "Donuts for Doggies": Alma and Rafia think they've invited too many people to Safina's bake sale.

eps.t: Hugs and Misses / Adventures in Kid-Sitting
eps.o: "Hugs and Misses": When Alma is put in charge of greeting people, she finds out that everyone has their own preferences on how they want to be greeted. "Adventures in Kid-Sitting": When Alma and Junior get a new sitter, Alma wants to figure out why Junior isn’t acting like himself.

eps.t: Alma's Shortcuts / Light Up the Block
eps.o: "Alma's Shortcuts": Alma takes shortcuts so she can play soccer with Beto, but she causes more problems in the long run. "Light Up the Block":When it’s too dark for the Nighttime Dance Break, Alma brings her community together to help light up the block.
